text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: canary-service-eu p99 latency jumped to 6.2s, p95 1.8s. 5xx rate increased from 0.3% -> 4.8% over last 3m. Canary traffic weight 12%.
jamie (oncall): ack. I'm looking. Where's the newest canary?
priya: canary rollout started at 3976543000, tag canary-v2.14.3, steps: compile-opt, small schema tweak. No config flags changed.
miguel: seeing a lot of upstream read timeout in frontend logs: 
```
ERR upstream/read timeout service=runtime host=10.2.4.11 duration=5.5s
stack: grpc call -> runtime handler -> compile-async
```
emily: metric spike on kvcache_evictions on the canary hosts at the same time. eviction rate x10. Could be causing extra backend work and stalls.
jamie (oncall): good catch. Are the canaries in eu-west1 only?
priya: yes, canary subset: eu-west1 cluster, 12% of traffic.
miguel: rolling a quick elastilog grep: 
```
$ kubectl logs svc/canary-service -l roll=canary -n prod | grep eviction | tail -n 50
[kv] evict key=abc duration=0.12s
[kv] evict key=def duration=0.10s
[kv] evict key=ghi duration=4.8s
```
jamie (oncall): that 4.8s eviction is suspicious. New compile path maybe holding locks. Any errors in kernel or OOM?
emily: no OOMs. CPU spiking on one host to 95%. The compile-opt path in v2.14.3 does a synchronous model compile on cold paths. If cache eviction thrashes, it can trigger compilation under load.
jamie (oncall): we need immediate mitigation. Options: reduce canary weight, kill canary pods, or rollback canary to v2.14.2. Thoughts?
priya: easiest fast route is rollback the canary. Reduces risk immediately.
miguel: I can run rollback. Command: 
```
kubectl set image deployment/canary-service canary=redwood/canary:v2.14.2 -n prod
```
jamie (oncall): do it. I'll notify support and product.
deploy-bot: rollback job queued by miguel at 3976543145, starting rollout undo.
opsbot: :information_source: rollback initiated, monitor group: #slo-watch, tracing link: https://grafana.example/reports/3976543210
priya: reducing canary traffic to 0 would also stop the noise, but rollback is cleaner.
miguel: rollback completed on 3/3 pods at 3976543192. New images v2.14.2 confirmed.
incident-bot: Note: p99 latency dropping to 0.6s within 30s of rollback. 5xx rate back down to 0.4%.
jamie (oncall): confirmed. Restoring normal behaviour. Good catch on kvcache eviction. :thumbsup:
emily: assigning postmortem to priya. Root suspect: synchronous compile path + cache eviction thrash under canary load.
priya: I'll own the postmortem. Immediate action items: 1) revert compile-opt gate until safe, 2) add eviction / compile latency guardrails to canary metrics, 3) add circuit to prevent compile on hot path when eviction rate > threshold.
sre_lead: taking handoff for next 12h to watch for regressions and customer escalations. Please DM if any customer reports appear.
jamie (oncall): summary for CS: about 12% of traffic in eu-west1 saw elevated 5xx and timeouts for ~3m during canary rollout. Some internal dashboards showed p99 up to 6s. No broad customer-impacting outage.
priya: estimated affected requests ~18k, error budget impact ~0.02%.
incident-bot: incident closed-to-ops at 3976543280. Follow-up: postmortem created and assigned.
miguel: leaving notes in the runbook: code path name compile_opt_sync and where to toggle the flag.
jamie (oncall): thanks all. If anyone finds additional anomalies in logs, ping me. :white_check_mark:
